explanation:
Constructed and checked as one valid solid, with a 145.320 × 198.850 × 50 mm envelope and minimum coordinates at zero within kernel tolerance. XY follows the principal drawing view; Z follows the bore. Features include the Ø80 bore, Ø90 × 10 counterbores at both ends, four mounting holes, 23 mm mounting plate, inclined hollow ribs, rounded triangular openings, concentric R58/R59.5 boundaries, underside reliefs, and the R5 hub-to-plate blend.

Limitations: this is not a fully resolved exact reproduction. Rear-pocket boundaries and lateral rib-window locations are inferred from the views. The 15, 8 and 5 mm relief depths are interpreted as the neck, lower-wing and small triangular recesses respectively. Detail D's 28.44°/30.02 callout associations and some side-view interface locations remain ambiguous; those local contours and undimensioned blends are inferred rather than claimed as fully dimension-constrained.
